name: Desktop-MCP
description: Visible, supervised Windows desktop control built on Windows-MCP
long_description: Control the real Windows pointer and keyboard through a local supervised MCP server. Smooth accelerated cursor motion, rich input batches, adaptive screenshot feedback, a native control window, and Ctrl+Shift+H emergency stop. Starts stopped; only the human can allow or resume control. Python 3.14+ required. The stop gate applies to this server, not unrelated shell tools.

screenshot_backend.title: Screenshot backend
screenshot_backend.description: auto selects DXGI, MSS or Pillow. Use mss or pillow if the display driver cannot supply captures.
